system.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

The medallion has 5 charges. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 13) from it. The medallion regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn.

notes: uses: a partial recovery refills the whole pool
not automated (utility): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
concentration: nothing it sustains was converted
not automated (save): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
